atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a % b 是余数 a - b * (a / b)，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

atoms.name: list_cons
atoms.rule: a ⊲ b places integer a before the elements of list b.
atoms.plain: a ⊲ b places integer a before the elements of list b.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⊲ b 把整数 a 放到列表 b 的最前面。

atoms.name: list_head
atoms.rule: a ⌃ is the first integer in a; an empty list gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a ⌃ is the first integer in a; an empty list gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⌃ 是列表 a 的第一个元素，空列表得 NaN。

atoms.name: list_tail
atoms.rule: a ⌄ removes the first element of a; an empty list stays empty.
atoms.plain: a ⌄ removes the first element of a; an empty list stays empty.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⌄ 去掉列表 a 的第一个元素，空列表保持为空。

atoms.name: list_length
atoms.rule: a ℒ is the number of integers in list a.
atoms.plain: a ℒ is the number of integers in list a.
atoms.plain_zh: a ℒ 是列表 a 的元素个数。

atoms.name: list_append
atoms.rule: a ⊞ b joins list a followed by list b.
atoms.plain: a ⊞ b joins list a followed by list b.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⊞ b 把列表 b 接在 a 后面。

atoms.name: list_sum
atoms.rule: a Σ is the sum of the integers in list a.
atoms.plain: a Σ is the sum of the integers in list a.
atoms.plain_zh: a Σ 是列表 a 所有元素之和。

atoms.name: list_at
atoms.rule: a ⊙ b is element b of a, counting from zero; an invalid index gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a ⊙ b is element b of a, counting from zero; an invalid index gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⊙ b 是列表 a 中下标为 b 的元素，下标从零数，越界得 NaN。

atoms.name: list_equal
atoms.rule: a ≍ b is true exactly when lists a and b have the same elements in order.
atoms.plain: a ≍ b is true exactly when lists a and b have the same elements in order.
atoms.plain_zh: a ≍ b 在两个列表元素和顺序都相同时为真。

domain.en: Values are lists of integers and integers. Lists may be empty; an index counts from zero.
domain.zh: 取值是整数列表和整数。列表可以为空，下标从零数起。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms.
A recursive call repeats its step at most this many times; larger counts give NaN.
settings.zh: 递归最多重复这么多步，更大的次数得 NaN。

settings.en: The largest number of cases in a branch definition.
settings.zh: 分支定义最多的情形数。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: ○₁
operators.plain: Append b to a, then apply ▼₁₂ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再对结果应用 ▼₁₂。

operators.name: ♧₂
operators.plain: If a equals [1], append a without its first element to []; otherwise drop the first element of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，在 [] 后面接上「去掉首元素的 a」；否则去掉 a 的第一个元素。

operators.name: ▽₃
operators.definition: a ▽₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ▽₃ (b - 1)) ⌄, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ▽₃ (b + 1)) ⌄, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): drop the first element of the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：去掉结果的第一个元素（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ☆₄
operators.plain: Subtract a ▼₁₂ from 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 1 中减去 a ▼₁₂。

operators.name: ★₅
operators.plain: Drop the first element of a, then append [1, 2] to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先去掉 a 的第一个元素，再在结果后面接上 [1, 2]。

operators.name: ■₆
operators.plain: Take the first element of a, then negate it.
operators.plain_zh: 先取 a 的第一个元素，再把结果取相反数。

operators.name: ♥₇
operators.plain: Append b to a, then take element 2 from it, counting from zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再取结果中下标为 2 的元素。

operators.name: ■₈
operators.plain: Apply ♥₇ to [1] and (a followed by b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [1] 和「a 后接 b」应用 ♥₇。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♠₉
operators.plain: Apply ★₅ to a, then append [1] to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ★₅，再在结果后面接上 [1]。

operators.name: □₁₀
operators.plain: Append b to a, then take its first element.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再取结果的第一个元素。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ◇₁₁
operators.plain: Put a ■₈ b at the front of [2, 3].
operators.plain_zh: 把 a ■₈ b 放到 [2, 3] 最前面。

operators.name: ▼₁₂
operators.plain: Add up the elements of a, then negate it.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 的元素加起来，再把结果取相反数。

operators.name: ▽₁₃
operators.plain: Apply □₁₀ to a and b, then add 1 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 □₁₀，再把结果加上 1。

operators.name: ▲₁₄
operators.plain: Add up the elements of a, then take the remainder when dividing it by 3.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 的元素加起来，再求结果除以 3 的余数。

operators.name: ♢₁₅
operators.plain: Append b to a, then apply ♥₇ to the result and [2, 3].
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再对结果和 [2, 3] 应用 ♥₇。

operators.name: ♡₁₆
operators.plain: Put a ■₈ b at the front of [].
operators.plain_zh: 把 a ■₈ b 放到 [] 最前面。

operators.name: ♢₁₇
operators.plain: Take the remainder when dividing 3 by the sum of the elements of a.
operators.plain_zh: 求 3 除以「a 的元素和」的余数。

operators.name: ♤₁₈
operators.plain: Apply ☆₄ to a, then negate it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ☆₄，再把结果取相反数。

operators.name: ○₁₉
operators.definition: a ○₁₉ b = { [] ♡₁₆ (a ◇₁₁ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ◇₁₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♡₁₆ to [] and (a ◇₁₁ b); otherwise compute a ◇₁₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，对 [] 和 a ◇₁₁ b 应用 ♡₁₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₁₁。

operators.name: ▲₂₀
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ▼₁₂ to a, then subtract 4 from it; otherwise apply ▼₁₂ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 应用 ▼₁₂，再从结果中减去 4；否则对 a 应用 ▼₁₂。

operators.name: ♡₂₁
operators.definition: a ♡₂₁ b = { (a ○₁₉ b) ◇₁₁ [], if a ≍ [1]; a ○₁₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ○₁₉ to a and b, then apply ◇₁₁ to the result and []; otherwise compute a ○₁₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ○₁₉，再对结果和 [] 应用 ◇₁₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ○₁₉。

operators.name: ▽₂₂
operators.definition: a ▽₂₂ b = { 3 ⊲ (a ♡₁₆ b), if a ≍ []; a ♡₁₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ♡₁₆ to a and b, then prepend 3 to it; otherwise compute a ♡₁₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₁₆，再把 3 放到结果最前面；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₁₆。

operators.name: ▲₂₃
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], subtract a ♤₁₈ from 3; otherwise apply ♤₁₈ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，从 3 中减去 a ♤₁₈；否则对 a 应用 ♤₁₈。

operators.name: ♥₂₄
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ◇₁₁ to [2, 3] and (a ★₅); otherwise apply ★₅ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，对 [2, 3] 和 a ★₅ 应用 ◇₁₁；否则对 a 应用 ★₅。

operators.name: ■₂₅
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ▲₂₃ to a, then subtract 2 from it; otherwise apply ▲₂₃ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 应用 ▲₂₃，再从结果中减去 2；否则对 a 应用 ▲₂₃。

operators.name: ♢₂₆
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♤₁₈ to a, then take the remainder when dividing it by 3; otherwise apply ♤₁₈ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 应用 ♤₁₈，再求结果除以 3 的余数；否则对 a 应用 ♤₁₈。

operators.name: ◇₂₇
operators.definition: a ◇₂₇ b = { 4 % (a ♢₁₅ b), if a ≍ []; a ♢₁₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], take the remainder when dividing 4 by a ♢₁₅ b; otherwise compute a ♢₁₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，求 4 除以 a ♢₁₅ b 的余数；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₁₅。

operators.name: ♧₂₈
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], subtract a ▲₂₃ from 4; otherwise apply ▲₂₃ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，从 4 中减去 a ▲₂₃；否则对 a 应用 ▲₂₃。

operators.name: ▽₂₉
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ♧₂₈ to a, then subtract 2 from it; otherwise apply ♧₂₈ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 应用 ♧₂₈，再从结果中减去 2；否则对 a 应用 ♧₂₈。

operators.name: ♥₃₀
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♡₂₁ to [2, 3] and (a ♧₂); otherwise apply ♧₂ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，对 [2, 3] 和 a ♧₂ 应用 ♡₂₁；否则对 a 应用 ♧₂。

operators.name: ♣₃₁
operators.plain: Apply ○₁₉ to [] and (a without its first element).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [] 和「去掉首元素的 a」应用 ○₁₉。

operators.name: ♤₃₂
operators.definition: a ♤₃₂ b = { (a ◇₁₁ b) ⌄, if a ≍ []; a ◇₁₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ◇₁₁ to a and b, then drop its first element; otherwise compute a ◇₁₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₁₁，再去掉结果的第一个元素；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₁₁。

operators.name: ♣₃₃
operators.plain: Put a at the front of b, then apply ○₁₉ to the result and [2, 3].
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 放到 b 最前面，再对结果和 [2, 3] 应用 ○₁₉。

operators.name: ★₃₄
operators.plain: Apply □₁₀ to a and b, then add 2 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 □₁₀，再把结果加上 2。

operators.name: ♠₃₅
operators.definition: a ♠₃₅ = { 1 - (a Σ), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a Σ, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], subtract the sum of the elements of a from 1; otherwise add up the elements of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，从 1 中减去「a 的元素和」；否则把 a 的元素加起来。

operators.name: ●₃₆
operators.plain: Apply ♣₃₃ to a and b, then prepend 2 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₃₃，再把 2 放到结果最前面。

operators.name: ★₃₇
operators.plain: Apply ♥₇ to a and b, then add 1 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇，再把结果加上 1。

operators.name: ▲₃₈
operators.plain: Apply ○₁₉ to [1] and (a ▽₂₂ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [1] 和 a ▽₂₂ b 应用 ○₁₉。

operators.name: ■₃₉
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ♢₂₆ to a, then negate it; otherwise apply ♢₂₆ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 应用 ♢₂₆，再把结果取相反数；否则对 a 应用 ♢₂₆。

operators.name: ♧₄₀
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♥₂₄ to a, then apply ▲₃₈ to the result and [1]; otherwise apply ♥₂₄ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 应用 ♥₂₄，再对结果和 [1] 应用 ▲₃₈；否则对 a 应用 ♥₂₄。

operators.name: ☆₄₁
operators.plain: Apply ▼₁₂ to a, then negate it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▼₁₂，再把结果取相反数。

operators.name: ■₄₂
operators.definition: a ■₄₂ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ■₄₂ (b - 1)) ♥₃₀, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ■₄₂ (b + 1)) ♥₃₀, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♥₃₀ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♥₃₀（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♣₄₃
operators.definition: a ♣₄₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♣₄₃ (b - 1)) ♧₄₀, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♣₄₃ (b + 1)) ♧₄₀, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♧₄₀ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♧₄₀（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ★₄₄
operators.definition: a ★₄₄ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ★₄₄ (b - 1)) ♣₃₁, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ★₄₄ (b + 1)) ♣₃₁, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♣₃₁ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♣₃₁（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♣₄₅
operators.definition: a ♣₄₅ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♣₄₅ (b - 1)) ★₅, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♣₄₅ (b + 1)) ★₅, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ★₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ★₅（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: △₄₆
operators.definition: a △₄₆ b = { a, if b == 0; (a △₄₆ (b - 1)) ♠₉, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a △₄₆ (b + 1)) ♠₉, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♠₉ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♠₉（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♥₄₇
operators.definition: a ♥₄₇ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♥₄₇ (b - 1)) ♥₂₄, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♥₄₇ (b + 1)) ♥₂₄, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♥₂₄ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♥₂₄（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♡₄₈
operators.definition: a ♡₄₈ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♡₄₈ (b - 1)) ♧₂, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♡₄₈ (b + 1)) ♧₂, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♧₂ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♧₂（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♡₄₉
operators.plain: Apply ♥₄₇ to a and b, then apply ♣₃₁ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₄₇，再对结果应用 ♣₃₁。

operators.name: ♥₅₀
operators.plain: Apply ♣₄₃ to a and b, then apply ♥₃₀ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₄₃，再对结果应用 ♥₃₀。

operators.name: ▽₅₁
operators.plain: Apply ♣₄₃ to a and b, then apply ▽₂₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₄₃，再对结果应用 ▽₂₉。

operators.name: ▲₅₂
operators.plain: Apply ♥₄₇ to a and b, then take element 0 from it, counting from zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₄₇，再取结果中下标为 0 的元素。

operators.name: ▽₅₃
operators.plain: Subtract a ▽₅₁ b from 0.
operators.plain_zh: 从 0 中减去 a ▽₅₁ b。

operators.name: ♦₅₄
operators.plain: Apply ▽₃ to a and b, then apply ■₂₅ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₃，再对结果应用 ■₂₅。

operators.name: ♤₅₅
operators.plain: Apply ▽₃ to a and b, then apply ■₆ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₃，再对结果应用 ■₆。

operators.name: ▽₅₆
operators.plain: Apply ◇₂₇ to [2, 3] and (a ♣₄₅ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 [2, 3] 和 a ♣₄₅ b 应用 ◇₂₇。

operators.name: □₅₇
operators.plain: Apply ★₄₄ to a and b, then apply ▽₂₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ★₄₄，再对结果应用 ▽₂₉。

operators.name: ◆₅₈
operators.plain: Apply ■₄₂ to a and b, then apply ◇₂₇ to the result and [1, 2].
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₄₂，再对结果和 [1, 2] 应用 ◇₂₇。

operators.name: ■₅₉
operators.plain: Apply ▲₅₂ to a and b, then apply ♦₅₄ to [2, 3] and the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₅₂，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 ♦₅₄。

operators.name: ♧₆₀
operators.plain: Apply ◆₅₈ to a and b, then take the remainder when dividing it by 4.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₅₈，再求结果除以 4 的余数。

operators.name: ♣₆₁
operators.plain: Apply ▲₅₂ to a and b, then add 2 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₅₂，再把结果加上 2。

operators.name: ■₆₂
operators.plain: Apply ♣₄₃ to a and b, then apply ♥₇ to the result and [1, 2].
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₄₃，再对结果和 [1, 2] 应用 ♥₇。

operators.name: ★₆₃
operators.plain: Apply ♡₄₈ to a and b, then count its elements.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₄₈，再数结果有几个元素。

operators.name: ▽₆₄
operators.definition: a ▽₆₄ b = { - (a ♣₆₁ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ♣₆₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♣₆₁ to a and b, then negate it; otherwise compute a ♣₆₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₆₁，再把结果取相反数；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₆₁。

operators.name: ●₆₅
operators.definition: a ●₆₅ b = { 4 ⊲ (a ♡₄₈ b), if a ≍ [1]; a ♡₄₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♡₄₈ to a and b, then prepend 4 to it; otherwise compute a ♡₄₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₄₈，再把 4 放到结果最前面；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₄₈。

operators.name: ♥₆₆
operators.definition: a ♥₆₆ b = { (a ♡₄₈ b) ♠₉, if a ≍ [1]; a ♡₄₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♡₄₈ to a and b, then apply ♠₉ to the result; otherwise compute a ♡₄₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₄₈，再对结果应用 ♠₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₄₈。

operators.name: ♢₆₇
operators.definition: a ♢₆₇ b = { [1] ■₅₉ (a ◆₅₈ b), if a ≍ []; a ◆₅₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ◆₅₈ to a and b, then apply ■₅₉ to [1] and the result; otherwise compute a ◆₅₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₅₈，再对 [1] 和结果应用 ■₅₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₅₈。

operators.name: ♤₆₈
operators.definition: a ♤₆₈ b = { [] ⊙ (a ♣₆₁ b), if a ≍ [1]; a ♣₆₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], take element a ♣₆₁ b of [], counting from zero; otherwise compute a ♣₆₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，取 [] 中下标为 a ♣₆₁ b 的元素；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₆₁。

operators.name: ♢₆₉
operators.definition: a ♢₆₉ b = { [1, 2] ▽₅₁ (a ▲₅₂ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ▲₅₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ▲₅₂ to a and b, then apply ▽₅₁ to [1, 2] and the result; otherwise compute a ▲₅₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₅₂，再对 [1, 2] 和结果应用 ▽₅₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₅₂。

operators.name: ☆₇₀
operators.definition: a ☆₇₀ b = { - (a ◆₅₈ b), if a ≍ [1]; a ◆₅₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ◆₅₈ to a and b, then negate it; otherwise compute a ◆₅₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₅₈，再把结果取相反数；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₅₈。

operators.name: ▲₇₁
operators.definition: a ▲₇₁ b = { (a ■₄₂ b) ♧₂, if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ■₄₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ■₄₂ to a and b, then apply ♧₂ to the result; otherwise compute a ■₄₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₄₂，再对结果应用 ♧₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ■₄₂。

operators.name: ◇₇₂
operators.definition: a ◇₇₂ b = { [2, 3] ○₁₉ (a ♣₄₅ b), if a ≍ [1]; a ♣₄₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ○₁₉ to [2, 3] and (a ♣₄₅ b); otherwise compute a ♣₄₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，对 [2, 3] 和 a ♣₄₅ b 应用 ○₁₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₄₅。

operators.name: △₇₃
operators.definition: a △₇₃ b = { (a ♥₄₇ b) ♥₅₀ 1, if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ♥₄₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ♥₄₇ to a and b, then apply ♥₅₀ to the result and 1; otherwise compute a ♥₄₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₄₇，再对结果和 1 应用 ♥₅₀；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₄₇。

operators.name: ♠₇₄
operators.definition: a ♠₇₄ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♠₇₄ (b - 1)) ●₆₅ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♠₇₄ (b + 1)) ●₆₅ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ●₆₅ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ●₆₅（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♥₇₅
operators.definition: a ♥₇₅ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♥₇₅ (b - 1)) ▲₇₁ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♥₇₅ (b + 1)) ▲₇₁ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ▲₇₁ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ▲₇₁（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♤₇₆
operators.definition: a ♤₇₆ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♤₇₆ (b - 1)) ♡₄₉ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♤₇₆ (b + 1)) ♡₄₉ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♡₄₉ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♡₄₉（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: □₇₇
operators.definition: a □₇₇ b = { a, if b == 0; (a □₇₇ (b - 1)) ◇₇₂ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a □₇₇ (b + 1)) ◇₇₂ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ◇₇₂ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ◇₇₂（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♢₇₈
operators.definition: a ♢₇₈ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♢₇₈ (b - 1)) ♥₅₀ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♢₇₈ (b + 1)) ♥₅₀ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♥₅₀ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♥₅₀（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ○₇₉
operators.definition: a ○₇₉ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ○₇₉ (b - 1)) ♥₆₆ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ○₇₉ (b + 1)) ♥₆₆ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♥₆₆ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♥₆₆（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♥₈₀
operators.definition: a ♥₈₀ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♥₈₀ (b - 1)) △₇₃ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♥₈₀ (b + 1)) △₇₃ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply △₇₃ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 △₇₃（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♦₈₁
operators.plain: Apply ♢₇₈ to a and b, then add up its elements.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₇₈，再把结果的元素加起来。

operators.name: □₈₂
operators.plain: Apply ♥₇₅ to a and b, then apply ☆₄ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇₅，再对结果应用 ☆₄。

operators.name: △₈₃
operators.plain: Apply ○₇₉ to a and b, then apply ♢₁₅ to the result and [].
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ○₇₉，再对结果和 [] 应用 ♢₁₅。

operators.name: ■₈₄
operators.plain: Apply ♦₈₁ to (a ♤₇₆ b) and 4.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a ♤₇₆ b 和 4 应用 ♦₈₁。

operators.name: ◆₈₅
operators.plain: Apply ♠₇₄ to a and b, then apply ♥₂₄ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♠₇₄，再对结果应用 ♥₂₄。

operators.name: ♦₈₆
operators.plain: Apply ♦₈₁ to a and b, then subtract 2 from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₈₁，再从结果中减去 2。

operators.name: ★₈₇
operators.plain: Apply ♥₈₀ to a and b, then apply ♤₃₂ to the result and [2, 3].
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₈₀，再对结果和 [2, 3] 应用 ♤₃₂。

operators.name: ♤₈₈
operators.plain: Apply ♦₈₆ to a and b, then apply ♢₆₇ to [1, 2] and the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₈₆，再对 [1, 2] 和结果应用 ♢₆₇。

operators.name: ○₈₉
operators.plain: Apply ♢₇₈ to a and b, then apply ●₃₆ to 4 and the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₇₈，再对 4 和结果应用 ●₃₆。

operators.name: ◇₉₀
operators.plain: Apply ♤₈₈ to a and b, then apply ▽₅₁ to [] and the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₈₈，再对 [] 和结果应用 ▽₅₁。

operators.name: ◇₉₁
operators.plain: Apply ○₈₉ to a and b, then apply ■₃₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ○₈₉，再对结果应用 ■₃₉。

operators.name: ◆₉₂
operators.definition: a ◆₉₂ b = { (a ○₇₉ b) ◆₈₅ 2, if a ≍ [1]; a ○₇₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ○₇₉ to a and b, then apply ◆₈₅ to the result and 2; otherwise compute a ○₇₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ○₇₉，再对结果和 2 应用 ◆₈₅；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ○₇₉。

operators.name: ♡₉₃
operators.definition: a ♡₉₃ b = { [1, 2] ☆₇₀ (a △₈₃ b), if a ≍ [1]; a △₈₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply △₈₃ to a and b, then apply ☆₇₀ to [1, 2] and the result; otherwise compute a △₈₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 △₈₃，再对 [1, 2] 和结果应用 ☆₇₀；否则对 a 和 b 应用 △₈₃。

operators.name: △₉₄
operators.definition: a △₉₄ b = { (a ♢₇₈ b) ▽₂₂ [2, 3], if a ≍ []; a ♢₇₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ♢₇₈ to a and b, then apply ▽₂₂ to the result and [2, 3]; otherwise compute a ♢₇₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₇₈，再对结果和 [2, 3] 应用 ▽₂₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₇₈。

operators.name: ▲₉₅
operators.definition: a ▲₉₅ b = { (a ◆₉₂ b) ◇₇₂ 1, if a ≍ []; a ◆₉₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ◆₉₂ to a and b, then apply ◇₇₂ to the result and 1; otherwise compute a ◆₉₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₉₂，再对结果和 1 应用 ◇₇₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₉₂。

operators.name: ☆₉₆
operators.definition: a ☆₉₆ b = { [2, 3] ♦₈₆ (a ■₈₄ b), if a ≍ [2, 3]; a ■₈₄ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 3], apply ■₈₄ to a and b, then apply ♦₈₆ to [2, 3] and the result; otherwise compute a ■₈₄ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [2, 3]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₈₄，再对 [2, 3] 和结果应用 ♦₈₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ■₈₄。

operators.name: ♢₉₇
operators.definition: a ♢₉₇ b = { [1, 2] ▽₅₃ (a ♡₉₃ b), if a ≍ [1]; a ♡₉₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1], apply ♡₉₃ to a and b, then apply ▽₅₃ to [1, 2] and the result; otherwise compute a ♡₉₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 [1]，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₉₃，再对 [1, 2] 和结果应用 ▽₅₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₉₃。

operators.name: ♦₉₈
operators.definition: a ♦₉₈ b = { [] ♤₆₈ (a ♦₈₆ b), if a ≍ []; a ♦₈₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [], apply ♦₈₆ to a and b, then apply ♤₆₈ to [] and the result; otherwise compute a ♦₈₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 []，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₈₆，再对 [] 和结果应用 ♤₆₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₈₆。
